narrative.text: The reply from Arcturia comes through their ambassador, not through formal diplomatic channels. Cray has responded personally — a rarity that Elara Vostane says indicates genuine interest rather than diplomatic courtesy.

Prime Minister Cray writes: 'Chancellor. Your letter was persuasive. Direct appeals between heads of government, bypassing the usual diplomatic machinery, are unusual — which is precisely why they sometimes work. I am authorizing an emergency economic aid package of 150 million VK equivalent, disbursed through the Arcturian Development Bank. The conditions are minimal: transparency on expenditure, quarterly reporting, and a commitment — personal, not institutional — that the funds will be used for the purposes described in your letter. I am taking a risk on you, Chancellor Ashavel. I hope you understand that risks of this nature are not something I extend often.'

choices.text: "One hundred and fifty million. Cray took a risk on me. I will not make him regret it — and I will not let this money disappear into the same bureaucratic machinery that got us into this crisis. Vostane, set up the oversight. I want every krone accounted for."
